name: cx-siren
task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) hard captures the commanded step 'Go to the exit', and the hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) is the exact template the wording 'whenever the siren rings, turn it off' calls for, with the condition first and the toggle as the response. The response closes when the agent toggles while the siren is on (satisfying every open owing step at once) and correctly fails if the siren is still ringing at the exit step, which the environment makes untoggleable; it is satisfiable in every setup (vacuously when no siren). No clause is added, missing, or redundant, and priorities match the categorical wording.

texts: Whenever the siren is ringing, toggle the switch to turn it off.
